text:
maya: CI microbench failed on PR #19666 — batcher_prefetch microbench is -7.3% vs gold. Marking as rollout blocker. full log: https://ci.redwood/inv/1743216789/19666
ci-bot: test=perf/microbench/batcher_prefetch status=FAIL threshold=-5%
artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/1743216789/19666
metrics: median_latency: 12.4ms -> 13.3ms (+7.3%), p95: 18.9ms -> 21.5ms
jon: is this reproducible locally or flaky? did the kernel-selector change in the PR diff?
kevin: running local reproducer + bisect now
kevin: ```bash
./tools/bench --bench=batcher_prefetch --seed=42 --iters=500
git bisect start
git bisect bad HEAD
git bisect good origin/main~5
# bisect points to commit abc1234 (runtime/kernel: switch to cost-model-v2)
```
sasha: I pulled the flamegraph from the CI artifact — top stacks show kernel::choose_path and kv_cache::evict scanning spiking. Looks like more kernel-hops increasing batch wait.
sasha: small snippet: ```
--- flamegraph top 
1) kernel::select_path +42%
2) kv_cache::lookup -> miss -> evict_scan +31%
3) batcher::wait_for_slot +28%
```
kevin: repro notes: with the bisected commit warmup iters=10 -> 20 to hit steady state changed hit-rate 72% -> 61%, so KV prefetched prefixes miss more after selector change.
olivia: can we revert abc1234 until we diagnose? i'll open a revert PR now.
maya: :thumbsup: put HOLD on rollout for this merge, tagging as rollout_blocker. pinging @oncall-eng-runtime
jon: long-term, add a microtest for kernel selection determinism across seq-len distributions and a small regression-check for kv-hit-rate on synthetic prefixes.
olivia: opened revert PR #19667 -> https://git.redwood/reverts/19667. CI queued.
perfbot: scheduled perf rerun queued (priority=high)
kevin: fallback if revert not clean: pin runtime config to cost-model-v1 for the next release and ship a follow-up to rework the autoselect heuristics.
maya: thanks everyone — keep updates here. if revert CI green we'll unhold and roll forward, otherwise we'll coordinate a hotfix.
